# Compile must not fail due to parse failure

A parse failure in any file must never fail the compile; coverage loss is reflected in statistics, but the pipeline continues.

Prevents a partial or failed file analysis from halting the overall compile process, ensuring robustness and resilience when extracting facts from a repository.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._extract`
